r: For the NVMe device given, provide information about the Reclaim Unit Handles associated with the Placement Handles of the namespaces in the specified Endurance Group.

-e <NUM>, --endgrp-id=<NUM>
The endurance group identifier to use when requesting the log page.
-b, --raw-binary
Print the raw buffer to the standard output stream.
-o <fmt>, --output-format=<fmt>
Set the reporting format to normal, json, or binary. Only one output format can be used at a time.
